categoriesAllowed.description: A war, a campaign, a battle or a siege: organised armed force between polities.
categoriesAllowed.label: War

categoriesAllowed.description: An agreement between polities: a treaty, a pact, an accession, a concordat.
categoriesAllowed.label: Treaty

categoriesAllowed.description: A vote that fills an office or a chamber, and the leadership contests that decide who stands in one.
categoriesAllowed.label: Election

categoriesAllowed.description: A seizure or a loss of power outside the ordinary rules: a revolution, a coup, an uprising, a mutiny.
categoriesAllowed.label: Revolution

categoriesAllowed.description: A constitution, a statute, a decree or a court ruling: the state changing what the rules are.
categoriesAllowed.label: Law

categoriesAllowed.description: Something coming into existence or ending: a state, an institution, a party, a company.
categoriesAllowed.label: Founding

categoriesAllowed.description: Harm from something nobody chose: an earthquake, a flood, a fire, an epidemic, a wreck.
categoriesAllowed.label: Disaster

categoriesAllowed.description: Money and what it does: a crisis, a bailout, a nationalisation, a currency, a trade agreement.
categoriesAllowed.label: Economy

categoriesAllowed.description: A work, a movement, a building, an exhibition, a broadcast, a sporting occasion.
categoriesAllowed.label: Culture

categoriesAllowed.description: A discovery, an expedition, a technology or a piece of engineering.
categoriesAllowed.label: Science

categoriesAllowed.description: A person's death, whether by illness, accident, execution or assassination.
categoriesAllowed.label: Death

categoriesAllowed.description: None of the above. A category the atlas has too few of to name yet, never a category nobody looked for.
categoriesAllowed.label: Other

rolesAllowed.description: Led the thing the event is about, without a named office to say so.
rolesAllowed.label: Leader

rolesAllowed.description: The king, president or equivalent, acting as such.
rolesAllowed.label: Head of state

rolesAllowed.description: The prime minister or equivalent, acting as such.
rolesAllowed.label: Head of government

rolesAllowed.description: Held a department and acted through it.
rolesAllowed.label: Minister

rolesAllowed.description: Commanded the force involved.
rolesAllowed.label: Commander

rolesAllowed.description: The state, regime or administration whose act this was.
rolesAllowed.label: Government

rolesAllowed.description: Stood against it, lost by it, or was excluded from it.
rolesAllowed.label: Opposition

rolesAllowed.description: A party that stood, won seats, or joined a coalition.
rolesAllowed.label: Party

rolesAllowed.description: Stood for the office at issue.
rolesAllowed.label: Candidate

rolesAllowed.description: Won the vote, the seat or the admission.
rolesAllowed.label: Elected

rolesAllowed.description: Was put in place by somebody else rather than elected.
rolesAllowed.label: Appointed

rolesAllowed.description: Was removed from power by the event.
rolesAllowed.label: Deposed

rolesAllowed.description: Left office by their own act.
rolesAllowed.label: Resigned

rolesAllowed.description: Fought in it, on either side.
rolesAllowed.label: Belligerent

rolesAllowed.description: Crossed into or annexed somebody else's ground.
rolesAllowed.label: Invader

rolesAllowed.description: Held ground it had taken.
rolesAllowed.label: Occupier

rolesAllowed.description: Was killed, injured or dispossessed by it.
rolesAllowed.label: Victim

rolesAllowed.description: Did the killing or the harm, or is said to have.
rolesAllowed.label: Perpetrator

rolesAllowed.description: The thing or person the act was aimed at.
rolesAllowed.label: Target

rolesAllowed.description: Signed the agreement.
rolesAllowed.label: Signatory

rolesAllowed.description: Negotiated it without necessarily signing it.
rolesAllowed.label: Negotiator

rolesAllowed.description: Lent the money or set the terms of the loan.
rolesAllowed.label: Creditor

rolesAllowed.description: Borrowed it and owed it.
rolesAllowed.label: Debtor

rolesAllowed.description: Backed, funded or patronised it without being party to it.
rolesAllowed.label: Supporter

rolesAllowed.description: Founded the thing the event brought into existence.
rolesAllowed.label: Founder

rolesAllowed.description: Joined it, or was the body joined.
rolesAllowed.label: Member

rolesAllowed.description: Asked to be admitted.
rolesAllowed.label: Applicant

rolesAllowed.description: Held the occasion on its own ground.
rolesAllowed.label: Host

rolesAllowed.description: Wrote or drafted the text at issue.
rolesAllowed.label: Author

rolesAllowed.description: A movement or front acting as one, without a party's shape.
rolesAllowed.label: Movement

rolesAllowed.description: A body acting in its institutional capacity — a bank, a church, an army, a court.
rolesAllowed.label: Institution
